description: Search the Wopee.io documentation (docs.wopee.io, from its llms-full.txt) and return the best matching sections with their page URL. Use it for questions about setup, configuration, environment variables, integrations (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Robot Framework), MCP clients, CI, concepts and troubleshooting, before guessing. Read-only, needs no API key, and does not touch the project. Results are cached for an hour.

maxResults.description: Number of sections to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

query.description: What to look up in the Wopee.io documentation, in plain words or exact names (e.g. 'WOPEE_PROJECT_UUID', 'cypress install plugin', 'self-healing locators').

name: wopee_search_docs
title: Search the Wopee.io docs
